Manipur Hooch Deaths Rise to 17, Six Arrested

The death toll from suspected spurious liquor consumption in Manipur has reached 17. Six individuals have been arrested in connection with the incident. Samples of the suspected liquor have been sent for testing, and 1,130 people have been screened.
